storyCards.headline: Summertime: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
D.j. Jazzy Jeff's "Summertime" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

Summertime was released in 1991.

Chart story — peaked at #4 on the Hot 100.
